items.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: They had, let's see, they had Rene, they had Rene, that, myself, Edna Mitchell, Joe Rene, Chester Lazard, Chester Lazard, and Henry Hardin, Thomas on guitar

ctx.x: They had, let's see, they had Rene, they had Rene, that, myself, Edna Mitchell, Joe Rene, Chester Lazard, Chester Lazard, and Henry Hardin, Thomas on guitar, and they had Manny Gabriel, Andy and this boy over the river, from over the lake. It was ten, ten pieces.
Who was Thomas on guitar? What was his name?
